{{- if .Values.ingress.enabled }}
  URL: https://{{ (first .Values.ingress.hosts).host }}/
{{- else }}
  Access the API via port-forward:

    kubectl port-forward -n {{ .Release.Namespace }} \
      svc/{{ include "effgen.fullname" . }} 8080:80

  Then: curl http://localhost:8080/health
{{- end }}

{{- if or (eq (.Values.env.EFFGEN_DEV_MODE | toString) "1") (eq (.Values.env.EFFGEN_DEV_MODE | toString) "true") }}

  ⚠️  WARNING: Running in DEV MODE — authentication is DISABLED.
     Set env.EFFGEN_DEV_MODE=0 and configure OIDC for production.
{{- end }}
